result.conclusion: The third leaf is provenance.zoningSource, NOT an independent defect: it carries the identical verdict="unmeasured" token as the zoning leaf (CTX-MIRROR's zoningSourceMirror copies it verbatim, legacy-design-tools PR #646). So the dispatch's 'THREE separate defects' framing is confirmed at the DEFECT-CLASS level (acreage bare-null vs. zoning-vocabulary leak are genuinely independent root causes) but NOT at the leaf-count level: 3 failing leaves map to 2 independent root causes, since zoning and provenance.zoningSource share one root cause by design (a mirror). Both are still counted and reported; neither is collapsed silently.

initialArchitectureFindings.acreage: src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs:157 lists baseFacts.acreage in REQUIRED_TIER1_FACET_PATHS. legacy-design-tools' bake (nodeFacetTier1Assemble.ts:328-330) writes `const acreage = ring ? parcelAcreage(ring) : (input.acreageWithoutRing ?? null)` -- a bare null, no absence object, whenever there is no parcel ring AND the CAD claim's land_acres is unusable. This is the SAME defect class CTX-LEAVES (2026-09-08) already fixed for 4 sibling leaves (baseFacts.situsCity, baseFacts.situsZip, baseFacts.landUse, provenance.landUseSource -- BAKE_OWNED_REQUIRED_LEAF_PATHS in nodeFacetBakeTier1Conformant.ts:470-475), via an earned Tier1LeafAbsence. baseFacts.acreage was not included in that leaf set and was not otherwise given an earned-absence path.
initialArchitectureFindings.zoning: verdictLayerServe.ts's LAYER_ABSENCE_VERDICTS is a deliberate 5-state vocabulary (absent-verified, lookup-failed, not-applicable, stamp-missing, unmeasured; doc 19 Section Layer, CTX card F, 2026-08-28) that is NARROWER in name overlap but WIDER in cardinality than the walk's four-state contract (value|absent-verified|not-applicable|refused). zoningVerdictFromCityLimits() emits verdict:"unmeasured" whenever the parcel lacks a zoning stamp and city-limits containment could not be determined. _decisions/2026-09-01_serve_path_never_emits_pipeline_state.md already rules that no served field may carry a pipeline-internal token and that the serve boundary must convert to absent-verified or refuse -- but that decision was never implemented against verdictLayerServe.ts's zoning path; the 5-state enum stands unmodified on origin/main today, tests included. This morning's classifier fix (P-124 CTX-LEAVES, verify-walk.mjs:254-284) is what now catches it -- previously any object fell through to an unconditional value/populated grade.
